moodClassification.logic: Slow, constant vertical movement mimics the breathing rate of an intimate performance. Use when the 808 is sustained and the melody is dark.
Rapid, full-body movement matches the high-energy high-hat rolls. Use when the BPM is >140 and the snare is aggressive.
Choreograph jumps (F5) to off-beat ghost notes. Use Size automation (Link to Peak Controller) to make the mascot physically 'pulse' with the low-end energy.
Side-to-side movement mimics the swaying of a live jazz performer. Use when Rhodes keys and clean guitars are dominant.

rhythmicSyncRules.action: Trigger Jump (F5) frame via MIDI exactly on the 2 and 4.
Automate Size from 50% to 100% over 1 bar to visualize the 'Weight' of the drop.

brandAestheticRules.action: Overlay a 20% opacity purple glass-card over the mascot window to match the DEEPER DIVES design system.
Set mascot size to 25% and position in the bottom-right corner to act as a silent metronome.
